summary: Tested backend (9/9 pytest passed) and frontend UI. Backend APIs all healthy: config, locations CRUD, comments, tags, images (upload+fetch via object storage), AI analyze (emergentintegrations gpt-5.2), emergency/send. Frontend: Mapbox map loads and renders canvas, sidebar shows seeded 'Torre Latinoamericana' location, time selector (Amanecer/Día/Atardecer/Noche) buttons are rendered. However a CRITICAL runtime error overlay covers the entire app: 'There is already a source with ID "mapbox-dem"' thrown inside Mapbox Map._render. This blocks all user interactions in the rendered dev build (error overlay intercepts clicks on sidebar/emergency/detail/etc.).

minor.issue: Uses location_id as QUERY PARAM on a POST (semantics inconsistent with rest of API which uses path params or JSON body). Works but error-prone for client consumers.
MOCKED behavior: endpoint only logs the alert and returns success; no real SMS/WhatsApp/email is sent. Highlight to user that emergency alerts are not actually delivered.

Uses `logger` inside init_storage() exception handler but `logger` is defined later in the file (after app/router setup). If storage init fails at import-time of init_storage call, will raise NameError. Currently benign because startup path succeeds, but is a latent bug.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: Mapbox runtime error 'There is already a source with ID mapbox-dem' is thrown from Map._render pipeline, causing a full-screen red CRA error overlay that blocks ALL user interactions (sidebar toggle, emergency button, location cards, time selector, detail panel). Likely triggers because the 'load' event handler runs more than once (React 18 StrictMode double-invoke or style re-load) and addSource/addLayer is called without existence guards. Fix: wrap addSource('mapbox-dem') and addLayer('3d-buildings') with `if (!map.current.getSource(...))` / `if (!map.current.getLayer(...))` guards, and idempotently init terrain/buildings. Also consider using a ref flag to avoid double-init.
Uses window.prompt() for naming a new location. Works but not aligned with the 'diseño minimalista' dark theme; consider shadcn Dialog input.

After main agent applies existence guards in the 'load' handler (and/or a one-shot ref to prevent double init from React StrictMode), re-run playwright flows for: sidebar open/close, click existing location card -> LocationDetail -> add tag/comment -> switch to AI tab -> analyze, image upload via [data-testid=image-upload-input], emergency dialog submit, time selector presets. All backend endpoints listed in the review request are verified working; use backend_test.py for regression.
rca of the issue: MapView.jsx registers a 'load' handler on the Mapbox Map that unconditionally calls addSource('mapbox-dem') and addLayer('3d-buildings'). In React 18 dev (StrictMode) the initMap effect can be invoked twice, and Mapbox may also emit 'load' on style reinitialization. The second invocation throws 'There is already a source with ID mapbox-dem' from Po.addSource -> Map.addSource (bundle.js stack confirmed). CRA dev overlay then renders a fixed red overlay on top of the app, making [data-testid=map-container] effectively hidden and blocking all pointer interactions. Mitigation: add `if (!map.current.getSource('mapbox-dem')) { map.current.addSource(...) }` and `if (!map.current.getLayer('3d-buildings')) { map.current.addLayer(...) }`, plus a `const initializedRef = useRef(false)` guard in initMap() to prevent duplicate init across StrictMode double-invocation.
